_howto: To add a post: write client/src/blog/<slug>.md and add an entry below (newest first). The page /blog/<slug>, the blog list, sitemap.xml, the RSS feed, llms.txt and the structured data all update automatically. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD. Keep each description unique, about 120-160 characters.

index.title: Courier Tracking Tips & Delivery Help – Track My Ship Blog
index.description: Practical help for parcels in India: what tracking statuses really mean, what to do when a delivery goes wrong, and how to make sure your courier arrives.
index.sub: Plain-language help for when a parcel is late, missing or stuck.

posts.h1: Parcel stuck in transit? Why tracking stops and what to do
posts.title: Parcel Stuck in Transit? Why Tracking Stops and What to Do
posts.description: No tracking update for days? Why parcels show In transit between hubs, when a long gap is normal, when it's a problem, and who to contact after 48 hours.

posts.h1: Received a damaged parcel? What to do
posts.title: Received a Damaged Parcel? What to Do in India
posts.description: Box crushed or item broken? What to check at the door, how to record evidence, who to contact (seller, courier or sender) and how to report it quickly.

posts.h1: Parcel shows Delivered but you didn't get it? What to do
posts.title: Parcel Shows Delivered but Not Received? What to Do
posts.description: Tracking says delivered but there's no parcel? Check these places first, then contact the courier and the seller in the right order, with the right details.

posts.h1: Out for delivery but not delivered: why it happens and what to do
posts.title: Out for Delivery but Not Delivered: Why and What to Do
posts.description: Your parcel was out for delivery all day and never came. The common reasons, what the next tracking scan tells you, and how to get it delivered.

posts.h1: What does RTO mean in courier tracking?
posts.title: What Does RTO Mean in Courier Tracking?
posts.description: RTO means return to origin: the courier is sending your parcel back to the sender. Why it happens, whether it can be stopped, and what to do next.

posts.h1: How to write a delivery address in India so your parcel arrives
posts.title: How to Write a Delivery Address in India (With Examples)
posts.description: A complete delivery address in India, line by line: name, phone, house, landmark, area, city and PIN code. Small details that stop failed deliveries.
